Kuvitus: keittiössä vasemmalla höyryävä: Illustration: in a kitchen, a steaming kettle on the left, with a clock beside it showing a short time, and a small table lamp on the right, with a clock beside it showing a long time. In the middle on the wall is an electricity meter.
Kuvaaja mittakaavassa: vaakapylväät näyt: Graph to scale: horizontal bars show how much energy a device transforms in one second. A kettle with a power of 2000 W transforms 2000 J, a toaster of 1000 W transforms 1000 J and a television of 80 W only 80 J. The length of a bar is directly proportional to the power.
Kuvaaja: energia ajan funktiona kolmelle: Graph: energy as a function of time for three devices that transform energy steadily. The 2000 W line of the kettle rises most steeply, the 1000 W line of the toaster rises half as steeply and the 80 W line of the television is almost horizontal. The slope of a line is the power: on the kettle's line 40 kJ is used in 20 seconds. The scales are evenly spaced and the graph is to scale.
Kuvaaja: kahden laitteen A ja B muuntama: Graph: the electrical energy E transformed by two devices, A and B, in kilojoules as a function of time t, when the devices transform energy steadily. The time axis runs from 0 to 80 s with gridlines every 10 s, the energy axis from 0 to 120 kJ with gridlines every 20 kJ. Line A starts at the origin and passes through the grid points (40 s; 60 kJ) and (80 s; 120 kJ). Line B starts at the origin and passes through the points (40 s; 20 kJ) and (80 s; 40 kJ). The scales are evenly spaced.
